nodes.text: @RpsAgainstTrump It is your patriotic duty to wear a respirator to prevent you from getting or spreading airborne diseases such as COVID, influenza, RSV, measles, hMPV, and more. This will reduce unnecessary consumption of healthcare resources and prevent massive disability and death. #MaskUp
